m: {James Bond} strolls in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} in his tuxedo and presses a gadget from Q, a wristwatch that grows one **chaste tree** on command. Purple blossom bursts through the *grass* and hoists the town *stocks* into the air, with a furious referee locked in them. Bond straightens his bow tie, snips a sprig of **chaste tree** for his lapel and murmurs, 'Branching out.'

{Cookie Monster} sits in {Front} of the {Waiting Room} and devours a giant cookie iced with one word, the family name **Cui**. The *lofty peak* beneath him is furious, shaking him by the bottom and booming its owners' name through a spray of crumbs. 'Me want more **Cui**!' he roars, and he starts on the snowy summit, which tastes of vanilla.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps up a *cliff* to the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and his sticky tongue snatches a *wild goose* out of the sky mid-honk. Gulp, and he lays it as a speckled egg, which cracks open on a furious **wild goose**. The *cliff* shakes as the whole V of geese dive-bombs him, and every **wild goose** honks his name back at him.

{Sherlock} raises his magnifying glass in {Front} of the {Funfair} and studies one crumb of caviar on a candyfloss stick. 'Elementary, Watson: **gentry**,' he says, smugly. A *silk thread* trails from the crumb to a duke's sash, pinned by a golden *skewer* that yanks him off the dodgems, and all the **gentry** tumble after him in their top hats.

{Sherlock} stands in {Front} of the {Mansion}, sunk on the sea floor, his pipe blowing bubbles as he squints at a pink twig. A weeping *king* swims up, and his *bamboo book* has turned to **coral**, page by page. One glance at the barnacled bookmark and Sherlock deduces it all: the *king* reads in the bath, and now even Watson's moustache is sprouting **coral**.

{Batman} fires his grappling hook in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and hauls a whole *tree* in from the *roadside*, then pins a **list of names** to its trunk with a batarang. The *roadside* comes along too, honking with traffic and flapping its signs. He growls every villain's name in his gruff voice, and at the bottom of the **list of names** he finds his own, in Alfred's handwriting.

{Sailor Moon} twirls through her long sparkly transformation in the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon}, then begins to **recite** her speech about justice, word for word. Each line pops out as a *small speech bubble* and drifts into a *tunnel*, which echoes it back wrong. She forgets line nine and howls with tears until Luna the cat whispers it, and the fish **recite** the rest in chorus.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} holding a gadget from his utility belt that beeps when he is **near** a suspect. It shrieks beside a *standing person* selling buns, and a strip of *roadside* rolls in under the door to give the stall somewhere to park. Batman edges closer, cape brushing noses, and growls that this is how **near** justice gets.

{Yoshi} licks up a *gentleman* in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} with one swipe of his sticky tongue, swallows him and lays him as an egg. The egg is even more **accomplished** than he was: it plays the violin, fences with a toothbrush and recites sonnets through its shell. The *gentleman* hatches and bows, and Yoshi, the least **accomplished** dinosaur present, says his own name.

{Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Casino} hugging a *wine jug* for the *feast*, and naturally a croupier whips it away like a football at the last second. Charlie flies through the air, lands flat, and a splash of strong **alcohol** soaks his zigzag shirt. The *feast* slides off its table in the fumes, the roulette wheel spins dizzily, and all that **alcohol** only makes him sigh, 'Good grief.'

{Darth Vader} raises one black glove {Inside} the {Beach}, and the Force hollows a stalk of *bamboo* into a **flute**. It floats up to his helmet, and his loud breathing plays through it, one long gloomy note after another. A *sprouting field* bursts through the sand and sways in time, while he booms his disapproval at every wrong note from the **flute**.

{Chewbacca} growls {Inside} the {Inn} while fixing a ship's engine on the landing, and only the *fowl* understand him. Hens pass the spanners, ducks hold the torch and a goose dangles from his bandolier. When a bolt snaps he roars and rips a sack of corn in half, and each loyal **fowl** roars right back, until the last **fowl** tightens the bolt with its beak.

{Walter White} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} in goggles, teaching his chemistry class, and a red *pennant* snaps up over each beaker, reading **do not** mix. A student reaches for the blue flask, and the *pennant* whacks his wrist. Walter taps the glass, announces that he is the one who knocks, and chalks a precise new rule on the wall: **do not** knock.

{James Bond} straightens his tuxedo in {Front} of the {Mint} and steps into Q's latest shoes, which make the wearer **graceful** for exactly ten seconds. He pirouettes past a *woman* dancing on a line spun by a tiny *silkworm*, and the *silkworm* applauds with all its legs. At second eleven he lands in a coin bucket, unruffled, and remarks that being **graceful** is overrated.

{Mario} crouches {Inside} the {Cat Café}, shuts one *eye* and tries to **take aim** for the perfect stomp on a mushroom thief hiding in a pot of *young crop*. The sprouts of *young crop* shuffle sideways to hide him. 'Wahoo!' Mario leaps, and in mid-air all twenty cats **take aim** at his red cap, so he lands on none of them and bags one coin.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Bathroom} of the {Swamp}, clicking a giant **building counter** as he deals a trick playing card onto each stilt house. A *towel* whips down from a ceiling and snatches the cards away, and a *schoolkid* paddles past, swapping all the houses round. The Joker squirts his flower at the **building counter**, it resets to zero, and he howls with delight.

{Kermit} flails his arms in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, clipboard out, as bandits drop through the *roof* to **plunder** his show. He stage-manages it anyway, yelling cues, and they **plunder** the props in perfect time: golden oars, crowns, one rubber duck. The *roof* flaps shut behind them like a curtain, and Kermit strums his banjo and sighs that it's not easy being robbed.

{Darth Vader} breathes loudly in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and uses the Force to float one huge glass *eye* behind a *busy man*, so he can **observe** him in secret. The man polishes each tile with a tiny cloth, then polishes a duck. Vader goes on to **observe** every stroke, booms his disapproval of the grouting, and the *busy man* polishes the eye.

{Homer} naps in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} until a sly clerk appears *holding meat* and offers him a pearly *shell* to move up the queue. 'Mmm, **bribery**,' says Homer, and he hatches a dim scheme of his own, stuffing a half-eaten doughnut in the *shell* for the receptionist. She reports the **bribery**, the doughnut is confiscated, and Homer wails, 'D'oh!'

{Cookie Monster} thunders into the {Basement} of the {Island} after a trail of crumbs, just as a *fruit picker* spills a basket of cookies across the floor. His *kicking foot* comes down to **step on** one: crunch. 'Me **step on** cookie!' he wails, googly eyes spinning, and he devours the foot-shaped crumbs, the basket and the mango the picker was holding.

{Tarzan} swings on a vine {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} and lets out his jungle yell, which arrives as a **clap of thunder**. The *rain* falls down in shock, pouring into the *courtyard* next door until it spills over the ropes. Baffled by the bell, Tarzan asks the elephants what it wants, yells again, and a second **clap of thunder** knocks out the champion.

{Walter White} adjusts his glasses in {Front} of the {Pool} and sets a soggy *crow* on the lab bench, a thermometer in its *mouth*. It lets out a tiny **whimper**, and he captures it in a beaker, proud of the precise pitch. He heats it gently, explains the science to his class, and the **whimper** boils into a long sad steam that the bird sniffles back up.

{Gandalf} mutters a spell in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} when a pipe starts to drip, and a floating *helping hand* appears from the tip of his staff. It joins his own *joined hands* to **cup hands** under the leak. Crankily he sets off a tiny firework in the water they hold, and a goldfish rises up to **cup hands** with its fins.

{Frodo} trudges on bare hairy feet in {Front} of the {Lake}, and a *woman* in phoenix robes, the **imperial consort**, demands his Ring for her crown. He slips it on and turns invisible, but she flicks a *coiled rope* that lassoes his ankle anyway. Sam wades in with a frying pan, and the **imperial consort** wins nothing but a very long walk home.

{Mario} head-butts a block in the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave}, out pops a coin, and the yeti yawns. It loves to **belittle** everything, even the mushroom that makes him grow ten feet tall. A blade of *grass* between its teeth chimes in, sneering at his moustache, so Mario stomps them both with a 'Wahoo!' and the flattened yeti carries on to **belittle** the stomp.

{Yoshi} paddles a *dugout canoe* into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} when a *small speech bubble* drifts from the emperor's statue, carrying a royal **decree**. His tongue shoots out, gulps it down, and he lays it as an egg stamped with a red seal. The egg cracks and bellows the **decree** that everyone must paddle, and the *dugout canoe* starts rowing itself round the marble hall, towing the curators.

{Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, and a giant spider, the very sort he dreads, pounces to **bind** him in *silk thread* from hairy toes to curly head. A *proclamation* flutters down declaring that all hobbits shall be wrapped. Loyal Sam arrives, shouts his name and unwinds him, then uses the same thread to **bind** the spider to a lilo.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room} exactly when he means to, and catches a *teetering man* slipping a *small speech bubble* to the clerk. It whispers that the man has waited a hundred years, which is **sly**, since he came at noon. 'You shall not pass!' cries Gandalf, tapping his staff, and the bubble becomes a toad, even more **sly**, who slips him a ticket.

{Pikachu} sparks {Inside} the {Jungle} and weaves *bamboo* into a tiny **sail**, lashing it to his Poké Ball to make a boat. A *chance meeting* with a startled parrot ends in a 'Pika!' and a Thunderbolt that crackles through the air. The **sail** fills with electric wind, and off he bowls through the trees, cheeks fizzing, with the parrot perched on top.

{Yoshi} gulps down the whole fountain in {Front} of the {Mansion} just as a *sudden flash* of lightning startles him into laying it as an egg. The egg splits, *water drops* burst out by the billion, and they **flood** the lawn, the gardens and the ground floor. He flutter-jumps above the waves crying his own name while the rising water goes on to **flood** the valley.

{Walter White} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} in his goggles, stirring a glowing solution in a *rice bowl* with a flick of his **wrist**, exactly forty turns. The *moon* in the window pulls the liquid up like a tide. He taps the glass and proudly notes that only a scientist's **wrist** could manage it, and then the rice sets into a solid white cuff.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Basement} of the {Pool}, blowing on *embers* under a giant pot and tricking a *busy man* into tossing in all his noodles. A label on the pot says never **boil**, which is the joke, since he squirts his flower on the coals and it starts to **boil** at once. Rubber ducks pop out wearing green wigs, and the man keeps stirring.

{Chewbacca} squeezes into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} and gapes at a *standing person* in a gown of fresh *moss*, so **pretty** the clerks forget to count. He growls a compliment only friends could understand, then rips the mirror off the wall in a temper at his own reflection. The *moss* creeps across his fur, he looks almost **pretty**, and a frog proposes.

{Zorro} swings from a chandelier {Inside} the {Pool} and, with three flicks of his rapier, slashes a Z across a wooden *pawn* from a giant chessboard. It snaps to attention, a real **soldier** in a tiny helmet. The *pawn* marches into the deep end, gurgling salutes, and twenty more follow, each a Z-marked **soldier**, as Zorro vanishes laughing over the diving board.

{Kermit} hops about in {Front} of the {Mansion} with a telescope to **survey** the grounds for tonight's show, flailing his one *strong arm*. That arm is gripping an *overflowing bowl* of soup, and each flail soaks another member of the cast. He hops up on the sundial to **survey** the wreckage, screams 'Yaaay!' and strums a panicked banjo chord as the chorus line slides away.

{Shrek} roars in {Front} of the {Inn} because someone has lit *incense* and rung a *chime stone*, and the air has turned horribly **fragrant**. All he wanted was to be left alone with his swamp stink. He bites a raw onion to fight back, but Donkey will not shut up, the *chime stone* keeps ringing, and even his layers now smell **fragrant**.

{Darth Vader} raises one glove in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and lifts a *bean* with the Force to **tease** a hungry duck. Each time its beak gets near, the bean floats a little further down the *road*, which curls along like a lazy river. Breathing loudly, he booms his disapproval of the duck's effort and goes on to **tease** it all the way to the bakery.

{Darth Vader} lifts the whole {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} with the Force and sets it down far out in the **outskirts**, among mile after mile of *rice field*. A farmer's *blanket* flaps off in the blast of his breathing and wraps round his helmet. Out here in the **outskirts** nobody is impressed, so he tells the *rice field* he is its father, and it only rustles.

{James Bond} falls down a chute into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} and lands in a *bargain bin*, where Q has stocked this mission's gadgets. Everything is **cheap**: the exploding pen only squeaks, the jet pack is a fan, the tuxedo is a paper bag. The *bargain bin* slaps a one-coin sticker on his forehead and he sighs, 'Bond. **Cheap** Bond.'

{Charlie Brown} lights a *campfire* in the {Basement} of the {Tower} and tosses noodles in a wok to **stir-fry** them for Snoopy. He adds a *pinch* of chilli, and at the last second the noodles leap away from his spoon like that football, so he falls flat on his back. They **stir-fry** themselves in a whirlwind round the room, and he sighs, 'Good grief.'

{Cookie Monster} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and lights a *campfire* under a *mountain* of cookies, to toast them all at once. The blaze turns the night gold, **glorious**, and the *mountain* glows like a sunrise made of chocolate chips. 'Me think this **glorious**!' he bellows, spraying crumbs, and he eats the mountain, the firelight and most of the door.

{Charlie Brown} goes down to the {Basement} of the {Hangar} with a *cane* and knocks out each wall, because here, at last, it is so **spacious** that no tree can catch his kite. The *attic* crashes down in a heap of dust, and planes taxi in for a look. The kite rises beautifully in all that **spacious** air, and a tree sprouts through the floor and eats it.

{Lara Croft} somersaults into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} and finds an ancient relic sealed in yellow **wax**, guarded by a *bug* the size of a boot. It gnaws a slab of *sun-dried meat* on a pressure plate, and she snatches the meat away, which springs the trap. Hot **wax** gushes from the walls, and she climbs out, ponytail shining, over the coated guests.

{Chewbacca} storms {Inside} the {Youth Hostel} and finds a *person* locked behind a *fence* in the hallway, a **prisoner** of the laundry rules. Roaring with loyalty, he rips the *fence* apart with his bare paws and hugs him. The freed man weeps, because now he must do laundry, so Chewbacca fixes the fence around himself and sits down, a very hairy **prisoner**.

{Lara Croft} opens a *cabinet* in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, lifts out a golden relic and hears a click. A giant spiky **chestnut** drops from a *tree* and rolls down a stone chute after her like the boulder in every tomb she has ever raided. She flips, cartwheels and vaults clear, ponytail flying, and the **chestnut** bursts on the sand and roasts in the sun.

{Gandalf} strides up in {Front} of the {Pool}, smells smoke, and taps an *antique* vase with his staff, because a spell can reveal any **crime**. Out spray fireworks and a *chili* that glows with guilt. 'You shall not pass!' he thunders at it, and the chili sneezes sparks. Crankily lighting his pipe on it, he declares the **crime** solved and arrests the vase as well.

{Darth Vader} lowers himself in the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, lifting a heap of *soil* with the Force and shaping it into a giant **cushion**. A guard snaps *handcuffs* on him, and he Force-chokes the *handcuffs* until they squeal and drop off. Then he sinks into the **cushion**, cape spread, his loud breathing slowing to a snore that rattles the vault.

{Darth Vader} stalks into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, breathing loudly, and sees a *woman* behind a glass *door*, twirling a sparkly pool noodle that outshines his red lightsaber. He starts to **envy** it so hard that the *door* rattles in the Force. He booms his disapproval and lifts the noodle away, and now the ducks all **envy** him.

{Kermit} flails {Inside} the {Waiting Room} with his clipboard, auditioning a crowd of spirits to be **chief** of tonight's show. The biggest *ghost* grabs the *dipper* and ladles soup over the others without waiting for a cue, which settles it: that one is **chief**. Kermit screams 'Yaaay!', plays a banjo fanfare, and the rest of the chorus bows, dripping.

{Yoshi} sits {Inside} the {Tower} and says the only thing he can say, his own name, and a *small speech bubble* carries it up the stairs as a **rumor**. By the second floor it says the tower is cheese. By the top, the **rumor** says the tower is a giant egg he laid, so he licks the wall with his long tongue, just to check.

{Mario} stomps the last enemy in the {Bathroom} of the {Fort} and looks up through the leaky *roof* at the *sunset*, which sinks without a word. A note says the princess is in another castle, and he feels terribly **lonesome**. He head-butts a block for company, but even the coin hops away, leaving him the most **lonesome** plumber alive, whispering a tiny 'Wahoo.'

{Sherlock} wades into the {Basement} of the {Pool} with a *fishing net* and scoops up a *curled worm*, which he studies through his magnifying glass. One tingling peppercorn on its tail is enough: 'Elementary, Watson, it has come from **Sichuan**.' The worm uncurls, burps chilli fire across his deerstalker, and the whole pool begins to taste of **Sichuan** hot pot.

{Sherlock} tests a theory in the {Basement} of the {Wine Cellar} by swinging a *bucket* round his head, because the only way to read a stain is to **fling** something. It flies off, lands on a *ski* and zooms across the barrels, and he deduces the rest from its path. Thrilled, he starts to **fling** bottles, corks and his pipe, while Watson dives for cover.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Spa} off a *cliff edge*, where *water drops* spray up from a painted sea, and he shoots his sticky tongue out at the **horizon**. It sticks. He reels the whole **horizon** in like a green noodle, swallows it and lays it as one long flat egg, and the *cliff edge* teeters, having nothing left to look at.

The {Joker} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Funfair} and carves a *tree* stump into a *pillow*, then hides a squeaker in it as a prank. Each ghost-train skeleton who lies on the **pillow** lets out a rude honk and sits up mortified. He cackles so hard that his green hair stands on end, and he deals out a trick card for every **pillow** he has rigged.

{Gandalf} rows up to the {Bathroom} of the {Island} and a **beggar** holds out a *begging bowl*, asking for a pinch of pipe-weed. Cranky but wise, Gandalf taps the *begging bowl* with his staff and mutters a spell. Fireworks fizz up, gold pours out and a coconut tree sprouts, and the **beggar** is now the richest man around, still begging for pipe-weed.

{Yoshi} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon}, where a *stream* sweeps across the floor, and he suddenly remembers he cannot **swim**. He flutter-jumps in panic, kicking *water drops* everywhere, and gulps down fish after fish, laying each as an egg that floats. Perched on his raft of eggs, he watches the little fish hatch and **swim** circles round him.

{Kermit} hops {Inside} the {Waiting Room} with his banjo, late for his own show, and a *big man* with his legs planted wide blocks the way. He flails, holds a *jade tablet* over his head like a shield and leaps straight at the **crotch** of those enormous trousers. Rrrip goes the **crotch**, the big man giggles, and Kermit shrieks 'Yaaay!' from the far side.

{Mario} kneels in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} with his plumber's wrench, because a giant *pinned heart* has sprung a leak. It starts to **secrete** *water drops* like sweat, and each one he stops pops up somewhere else. He stomps the valve, a coin flies out, and now the heart begins to **secrete** perfume, so the crabs line up and Mario sighs, 'Wahoo.'

{Yoshi} paddles a *dugout canoe* {Inside} the {Museum} along a *road* painted across the floor, where a sign sets the limit at slow. He flutter-jumps clean over the rope, canoe and all, and goes on to **exceed** it by a mile. The *road* curls up after him, the guards give chase, and each egg he throws makes them **exceed** it too.

{Darth Vader} stands in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} when a mosquito whose *mouth* is tipped with a rusty *nail* tries to **sting** his helmet. Clank, clank. Vader Force-chokes the *nail* until it squeaks and booms his disapproval, so the mosquito drifts off to **sting** the champion on the nose, and the champion punches the referee.

{Darth Vader} looms in the {Bathroom} of the {Island} and with the Force he stirs *soot* and oil into **eyebrow paint**, floating a brush through the air. It draws two thick black arches on his helmet, so he looks permanently surprised. His *stand-in* walks on stage wearing them too, the crowd gasps, and every parrot squawks for **eyebrow paint**.

{Zorro} flings open the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} with a swish of his cape, and a hot wind from a *campfire* blasts out, the air so **dry** that his rapier throws sparks. He slashes a Z on the wall and it crumbles to dust. The morning *birdsong* cracks into croaks, the parrots crackle, and his moustache goes **dry** as toast, yet he vanishes, laughing hoarsely.

The {Joker} pops out of the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and starts to **throw** trick playing cards at the bees, cackling. A *helping hand* springs from his sleeve on a spring and grabs a *pitcher* of honey, and he goes on to **throw** that too. It bursts on his own purple suit, so the bees forgive him and he grins, sticky and thrilled.

{James Bond} strolls {Inside} the {Beach} in Q's newest spring-loaded shoes, which can only **tread on** things. The sand gives way to a *ploughed field*, whose furrows ripple to trip him, while *grass* whips at his ankles in protest. He has to **tread on** a tomato, a melon and a sleeping crab before stepping off, unruffled, to say, 'Mind the step.'

{Sherlock} stops in {Front} of the {Pool} at a giant gate held up by a *tree*, pulls out his magnifying glass and hears one squeak. A glance at the *district map* and a sniff of oil, and he deduces it: 'Elementary, Watson, the **hinge**.' He gives the **hinge** a smug tap with his pipe, and the gate spins so fast that Watson flies off.

{Zorro} leaps from his black horse in {Front} of the {Jungle}, his *standing heart* burning, and slashes a Z through a bamboo *steamer*, for he must **detest** dumplings with all his dashing soul. The monkeys only steam more of them. He goes on to **detest** the monkeys too, until one hands him a dumpling, and he vanishes laughing with his mouth full.

{James Bond} adjusts his cufflinks in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} when a **whale** bursts through the canvas and swallows him, tuxedo and all. This *fish* carries a tiny *palace* on its back, whose chandeliers rattle at every gulp. Bond inflates Q's pocket submarine, sails out of the **whale** through its blowhole, lands on the palace balcony and says it was a whale of a time.

{Homer} wanders {Inside} the {Lagoon} with a *bow* taller than a house and a dim scheme: fire a doughnut far enough to feed him for life. He draws it back past his *elbow*, and the shot is a **great** one, circling the whole planet. 'Mmm, **great**,' he says, mouth open, and it comes round again and bonks him on the head. 'D'oh!'

{Yoshi} curls up in the {Basement} of the {Beach} and starts to **lean on** a *standing person*, who never moves, ever. The *oddball* opens one eye and leans back, so they prop each other up like two playing cards. Yoshi yawns, stretches his long tongue and lays a startled egg, and now all three **lean on** one another.

{Walter White} measures chlorine in the {Basement} of the {Pool} when a *standing person* comes down to **insult** his goatee, calling it seaweed. Walter pushes up his glasses and takes it as a chemistry problem, weighing every word on his precise scale. The *busy mother* who runs the pool marches over to **insult** the insulter, and Walter records the reaction, proud of the data.

{Frodo} plods in {Front} of the {Mansion} on bare hairy feet, weary from a very long walk, and finds his way barred by a **hedge** of *grass* and twigs. A goat kicks over a *slop bucket*, and the **hedge** gobbles the slops and swells taller than the chimneys. Frodo slips on the Ring to sneak through, while loyal Sam sighs and picks up the shears.

{Frodo} tiptoes {Inside} the {Pool} on bare feet when a *dollar sign* floats up and sticks in the hair on his toes, tempting him like the Ring. A *helping hand* darts out to **brush off** the money, but more arrive, whispering sweetly. Weary but stubborn, he goes on to **brush off** each one, and the swimmers dive after them, leaving him alone with Sam.

{Homer} pokes his head into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and spots a tall white *crane* napping on one leg, which gives him a dim idea. A smaller *bird* tries to copy it and falls over, and Homer tries too, doughnut in hand. 'D'oh!' he yells as he topples, and the **crane** gulps the doughnut, while another **crane** lifts off and leaves him.

{Sherlock} sits {Inside} the {Beehive} with a *side dish* of honey cakes, and his magnifying glass finds one neat tiny hole. 'Elementary,' he says smugly, for a greedy *bug* has begun to **eat into** the cake, crumb by crumb. He follows the trail with his pipe as it goes on to **eat into** the staircase, the hive and finally Watson's boots.

{James Bond} stands in {Front} of the {Stadium} and orders his *water* shaken, not stirred, with a spoon of flour in Q's cocktail shaker. The shaker whirrs until the *water* thickens to a gloopy **thick liquid** that glugs out over the pitch. Footballers slide past on their bellies, the goalposts sink, and Bond, spotless, sips some **thick liquid** and calls it a sticky situation.

{Frodo} wades {Inside} the {Pool} on his hairy feet, longing for one flat place to rest, and clambers onto a pink **lotus** ringed with *grass*. A *husband* in swim trunks is already sitting on it and refuses to budge, so Frodo slips on the Ring and sits on him invisibly. The man yelps, and the **lotus** bobs off like a boat.

{Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Boathouse} with a new kite of shining **silk**, certain that this time it will fly. The {Joker} perches in {Front} of the {Swamp} with a huge grin, offering free **makeup** to a *woman* sitting on a *split log*. {Kermit} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Casino}, where a *helping hand* passes him a **bundle** of banknotes from a *trapped tree* tied up in rope. {Chewbacca} storms up in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} waving *gold coins* that weigh far too much, and in a temper he rips one apart with his teeth. It is grey **lead**, painted yellow. {Gandalf} pops out of the {Bathroom} of the {Swamp} and starts to **stroll** along a muddy *road*, puffing his pipe and arriving exactly nowhere on purpose. A *mad dog* races up, barking. {Sherlock} sits in {Front} of the {Pool} beside his *uncle* and, glancing at one damp teacup, deduces the whole man: so **gentle** that he catches *water drops* so they will not hit the swimmers. {Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Youth Hostel} to a *tree* growing on a stone altar, with one **pomegranate** hanging like a holy relic. {Batman} broods in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, setting a camera on a *tripod* to check the Batmobile's time in the race. {Yoshi} lies on a *sickbed* in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} when a *sheep* rubs its wool on his feet and they begin to **itch**. {Charlie Brown} stands in {Front} of the {Tower} with a pot of *gold coins*, melts them, adds a *pinch* of salt and rolls them flat into **paper money**. At last, he thinks, his luck has turned. {Tarzan} swings on a vine {Inside} the {Beach} and lands beside a horse sent by the *sky god*, and asks it in its own language why it looks so glum. {Chewbacca} squeezes into the {Basement} of the {Mint}, where a *dog* guards a mountain of coins, and he lets out a mighty roar. Bankers come running, the *dog* wags so hard that coins fly everywhere, and Chewbacca hugs the **dog** and straps it to his bandolier.

{Gandalf} stands in {Front} of the {Lagoon} and cranky as ever taps his staff, casting a spell that forces all to **bow** to the sunrise. The {Joker} pops up in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} at *sunrise* and lays a giant *ruler* across the river, sneering at how slowly the light climbs. He flips a trick playing card, and suddenly the sun is a joke sun, jumping to full **daytime** in a blink. The *ruler* snaps with laughter, and all **daytime** long he cackles at the sleepy owls.

{Zorro} crashes through a window into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and lands in a *bath*, where green *grass* sprouts from the plughole: **aquatic grass**, waving like hair. The {Joker} tiptoes in {Front} of the {Pool} and dangles a huge fake **spider**, painted in shiny *red lacquer*, right over the swimmers, cackling. A little *bug* stuck to it waves for help. {Homer} drops a chocolate doughnut in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and, lunging for it, smears his white *shirt* a deep gooey **brown**. {James Bond} lounges {Inside} the {Piazza} and flicks open Q's newest *tongs*, built to do only one thing: pinch a **cheek**. {Darth Vader} drops into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a *chieftain* and a *big man* are arguing over a heap of gold. {Mario} head-butts blocks by the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} at *sunset* to **raise funds** for a new diving board, and each block spits out a coin. {Darth Vader} reclines in {Front} of the {Mansion} with his helmet's *ear* sunk in a fluffy *pillow*, and he reaches out with the Force to hold back the hands of each clock. {Darth Vader} stamps through the {Basement} of the {Tower} to his own marching music, and his *kicking foot* starts to **tread** on piles of rice with a boom at each step. {Lara Croft} leaps across a spike pit into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and solves a door puzzle, only to find a shack on a bare *hillside*. {Lara Croft} cartwheels through the {Basement} of the {Museum} and finds a *standing person* made of nothing but a *spine*, a skeleton chained to an old stone puzzle. {Mario} leaps out of the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} and meets a *ghost* hiding shyly behind a *sapling*, covering its eyes the moment he looks. {Lara Croft} climbs {Inside} the {Mansion} up a sheer indoor *mountain*, hand over hand, her ponytail streaming in the *wind*. The {Joker} tiptoes {Inside} the {Beehive} with a squirting flower, cackling, and a *standing person* waits at the *arrow landing* holding a bow: his **nephew**, a tiny boy with green hair and an even bigger grin. {Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Boathouse}, which somehow holds an **arable field**, with one *rice field* beside it for Snoopy. He plants kite seeds, because this year must be his year. {Robocop} clanks stiffly into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair}, and a steel spike with a gleaming *blade edge* slides from his fist.
